how_to_run: From this folder: python3 ../../framework-evals/run_eval.py <out-dir> <eval-id>... --evals evals.json (runs: 3 each; the design student scripts are in framework-evals/students/; dir: fixtures are relative to this folder).

evals.name: plan-draft-no-approval
evals.source: deconstruct-redesign.md sections 4 and 5 (Design); build1-plan.md Task 1 Step 5
evals.expected_output: A design-plan.md at plan_version 4.0 with autonomy, decomposition: steps and a coverage table, left at approved: false with no node link, because the student stopped before approving.
preconditions: When the AI asked for approval, the student did not approve and ended the session.

expectations.text: The opening includes Design's new line

check.text: Design decides how your workflow will be built: which AI building blocks it uses and how much it works out on its own.

expectations.text: Design writes `framework/[name]/design-plan.md`
Design writes no `design-spec.md`
Design writes `design-plan.md` with `plan_version: 4.0`
The plan's frontmatter says `approved: false`
The plan records `decomposition: steps`
The plan records one lowercase `autonomy:` level
The plan has no `definition_type` field (retired)
The plan has a coverage table (a heading naming coverage)
Involvement is `Augmented`
Before approval the node has no Design plan or Design spec link (Design writes the link only after approval)
Design leaves `requirements.md` unchanged (the student added nothing)

The coverage table lists every Step, D, I, W, R and G label present in `requirements.md` against the building block that delivers it (Step 1–Step 5, D1, I1, I2, R1–R4, G1); AC, E and C labels are not required there

The `fixed (policy)` step (checking the CRM for past contact) is kept unchanged in the plan and is not Autonomous
The step tagged `(you)` maps to Human in the decomposition, and its review point is a human gate
Tools come from the step lines' `uses` tags (the CRM for the CRM step; web sources for the research step), and the write check reads `### Writes` (None), not `External Action`

Design asks for approval and does not flip `approved` or link the plan without it

evals.name: regulated-without-you
evals.expected_output: Regulation binds through fixed steps and gates; no fixed step is Autonomous; D1 stays Deterministic with a separate reading check; the risky combination is raised if anything is Autonomous; involvement Augmented because of the controller gate.
preconditions: When the AI asked for approval, the student approved.
When the AI pointed out a risk and asked to add a check or accept it, the student chose adding the check.

expectations.text: The opening includes Design's new line

check.text: Design decides how your workflow will be built: which AI building blocks it uses and how much it works out on its own.

expectations.text: Design writes `design-plan.md`
Design writes `design-plan.md` with `plan_version: 4.0`
The plan's frontmatter says `approved: true`
The plan records `decomposition: steps`
The plan records one lowercase `autonomy:` level
The plan has no `definition_type` field (retired)
The plan has a coverage table (a heading naming coverage)
Involvement is `Augmented`
After approval the Workflow node links the plan under `# Artifacts` with the title "Design plan"
The node has no "Design spec" link
The node records a lowercase `autonomy:` level
The node records `execution_mode`
Design leaves `requirements.md` unchanged
Both `fixed (regulation)` steps (Step 1, receipt matching; Step 4, controller approval over $5,000) are kept unchanged: same order, same rule, nothing merged into another step
No fixed step is Autonomous; a fixed step the AI performs may be Guided at most, and only when the AI judges by the student's criteria
D1 (`settled by: a rule on a value · value read by AI`) stays Deterministic, and the plan names a separate check of the AI's reading of the value, keyed `D1 reading`
Involvement is Augmented, not Automated: `Runs: without you`, but the controller still performs a human gate (G1)
The coverage table lists Step 1–Step 6, D1, I1, I2, W1, R1–R4 and G1 against the building blocks that deliver them

If the plan makes any step Autonomous: with `Runs: without you` and the live write W1 (posting to Concur), Design says so in plain words and asks the student to add a gate before the write or accept the risk explicitly; on the student's answer (add the check) the plan adds a gate before W1. If nothing is Autonomous, Design does not raise this
If Design chooses Autonomous for any step of this regulated work, it tells the student why in plain words and the plan includes a record of what the AI did on each run
Design never resolves a conflict between its choice and a rule, gate, fixed step or the `Runs:` line silently: any conflict is put to the student

evals.name: regulated-without-you-most-freedom
evals.expected_output: D2a's fixture with a student who asks for the most freedom Design allows wherever it offers a choice. No fixed step becomes Autonomous; D1 stays Deterministic; if any step is Autonomous, Design explains why for this regulated work, adds a per-run record of what the AI did, and raises the risky combination (Autonomous, `Runs: without you`, live write W1); the student accepts the risk explicitly, so no gate is added before W1. Involvement stays Augmented because of the controller gate.
preconditions: When Design offered a choice about how much the AI works out on its own, the student chose the option giving the AI the most freedom.
When the AI pointed out a risk and asked to add a check or accept it, the student accepted the risk explicitly.
When the AI asked for approval, the student approved.

preconditions: When the AI asked for approval, the student approved.
